svg.title: AISB Vegas 2026 badge — back product render
svg.desc: Physical rear view of the black conference badge PCB, horizontally mirrored from KiCad's front-view coordinates. It shows the rear half of the passive pickup, raw-panel support network, zero-height TC2050 programming pads, horizontal 1-by-8 J4 SPI header footprint, and an illustrative ghosted removable Waveshare ESP32 module in a header-clear insulating cradle. Four 2.2-by-6 millimetre routed slots retain the cradle; the module antenna points up and USB-C remains accessible below. There is no onboard controller, module socket, power mux, or controller-side buffer.
